text: Ireland is vulnerable to global trade disruptions, geopolitical tensions, commodity price volatility, cyberthreats, and MNE retrenchment due to its concentration in pharmaceutical manufacturing and ICT. Risk likelihoods reflect high (30–50 percent), medium (10–30 percent), and low (below 10 percent), with high likelihood and high expected impact attached to trade disruptions, geopolitical conflicts, commodity volatility, and volatile MNE activities. Staff recommend allowing automatic stabilizers to operate, using fiscal buffers, accelerating high-quality public investment in infrastructure and housing within a broadly neutral fiscal stance, and increasing oversight of NBFIs.
